d.t: 1-component neutral cure wet area silicone sealant
d.s: SikaSeal Kitchen and Bathroom is a one-component, neutral curing, low odour silicone sealant with excellent adhesion. SikaSeal Kitchen and Bathroom cures through the absorption of atmospheric moisture to give a tough but flexible waterproof seal.
a: Excellent adhesion to most common construction materials such as: glass, enamel, ceramics, tiles, most metal*, most plastic, rubber, concrete and grouts
us: General interior & exterior sealing around the home

sec.t: 12 months from date of production if stored in undamaged and unopened original sealed containers.
Storage in dry conditions and protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.

The joint width must be designed to suit the joint movement required and the movement capability of the sealant. The joint width shall be ≥ 6 mm and ≤ 45 mm. The joint depth shall be ≥ 6 mm and ≤ 15 mm. A width to depth ratio of 2:1 must be maintained (for exceptions, see table below). Typical joint dimensions. Joint Width (mm) | Joint Depth (mm) | Joint Length /600 ml ssg | 6 | 4 | 25 mm | 9 | 5 | 13 mm | 12 | 6 | 8 mm | | All joints must be correctly designed and dimensioned in accordance with the relevant standards, before their construction. The basis for calculation of the necessary joint widths are the type of structure and its dimensions, the technical values of the adjacent building materials and the joint sealing material, as well as the specific exposure of the building and the joints. For larger joints please contact Sika technical service.
+5 °C min./+40 °C max. Minimum +3 °C above dew point temperature

The substrate must be clean, dry, sound and free from oils, grease, dust, cement laitance and loose or friable particles. For optimum adhesion, joint durability and critical, high performance applications such as joints on multi-storey buildings, highly stressed joints, extreme weather exposure or water immersion/exposure. The following priming and/or pre-treatment procedures must be followed: Non-porous substrates Float glass, coated glass, anodised aluminium and stainless steel must be pre-treated using Sika Aktivat-or-205 or Sika Aktivator-100. Powder coated and PVDF coated metals must be pre-treated using Sika Aktivator-205. For more details such as application and flash-off times, refer to the most recent Product Data Sheet of the respective pre-treatment product. Porous substrates Concrete, aerated concrete and cement based renders, mortars and bricks must be primed using Sika Primer-3 N. For more details such as application and flash-off times, refer to the most recent Product Data Sheet of the respective pre-treatment product. Adhesion tests on project specific substrates must be performed and procedures agreed with all parties before full project application. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information. Note: Primers and activators are adhesion promoters and not an alternative to improve poor preparation/cleaning of the joint surface. Primers also improve the long term adhesion performance of the sealed joint.
Clean all tools and application equipment with Sika Remover-208 immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin, use Sika Cleaning Wipes-100.

cp.text: *Not for use on all metal substrates i.e. copper. -See Important Considerations below prior to use.
cp.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

cp.text: Do not use on natural stone.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: Do not use on bituminous substrates, natural rubber or any building materials which might leach oils, plasticisers or solvents that could degrade the sealant
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: Do not use SikaSeal® Kitchen and Bathroom in areas which are exposed to strong oxidising acids (e.g. nitric acid) and bases.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: Do not use to seal joints in or around swimming pools.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: Do not use for joints under water pressure or permanent water immersion.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: Do not use SikaSeal® Kitchen and Bathroom in totally confined spaces as it requires atmospheric moisture to cure.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: Do not use for medical or pharmaceutical applications.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: Porous substrates Concrete, aerated concrete and cement based renders, mortars and bricks must be primed using Sika® Primer-3 N. For more details such as application and flash-off times, refer to the most recent Product Data Sheet of the respective pre-treatment product

hazard_statements.statement: May cause an allergic skin reaction.
hazard_statements.text: H317 May cause an allergic skin reaction.

precautionary_statements.text: P261 Avoid breathing mist or vapours.

precautionary_statements.statement: Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.
precautionary_statements.text: P272 Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P280 Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.
precautionary_statements.text: P302 + P352 IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.
precautionary_statements.text: P305 + P351 + P338 + P310 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.

precautionary_statements.statement: If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P333 + P313 If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.
precautionary_statements.text: P362 + P364 Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

precautionary_statements.statement: Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.
precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

eyes.label: Eye protection
eyes.text: Safety goggles Wear suitable face shield.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
